reading: The sketch lays out a GitHub-style PR review page: a top bar with title, Open pill, merge note, tab strip and a Review-changes button; a left file-tree sidebar; a large split-diff code panel; and a comment thread panel at the bottom of the diff area. Typed notes give exact text, sizes, colours and positions for every part.
